mechanism: Empagliflozin increases urinary glucose excretion and enhances insulin's glucose-lowering effect, increasing hypoglycemia risk; empagliflozin also carries risk of diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) when combined with insulin.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, educate patient on hypoglycemia symptoms, consider insulin dose reduction, and monitor for signs of DKA (nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, dyspnea); ensure adequate hydration.
